invariants.expression: result == (super.touchDown(event, x, y, pointer, button) && ((pointer != 0 || button == 0) && !disabled))
invariants.rationale: This captures the exact branching logic leading to possible returns.

invariants.expression: (!super.touchDown(event, x, y, pointer, button) || ((pointer == 0 && button != 0) || disabled)) == !result
invariants.rationale: If any early return branches are taken, result is false.

invariants.expression: pointer != 0 || result == (super.touchDown(event, x, y, pointer, button) && !disabled)
invariants.rationale: If pointer != 0, button check is irrelevant in branching; relates pointer and result.

invariants.expression: pointer == 0 || button == 0 || result == (super.touchDown(event, x, y, pointer, button) && !disabled)
invariants.rationale: If either pointer != 0 or button == 0, disables intermediate false return.
If disabled, always returns true, otherwise if result is true, pointer==0 and button==0 branch is enabled.
